summary: Iter 62 — Verified recipient email resolution centralization via _resolve_client_email(client, quotation). All 13 tests passed (5 unit + 8 E2E). Bug fix confirmed: agency/wholesale/operator clients now send to the assigned executive's email, NEVER to the general/CEO email. Errors are surfaced as HTTP 400 with specific messages when the executive has no email or no executive is assigned.
critical_code_review_comments: deps._resolve_client_email is a clean pure helper — returns (email, error) tuple; used consistently in quotations.send_quotation_message (L713), public_payments.send_payment_link (L404), and booking.py (L418). Import wiring correct.

public_payments.request_bank_transfer (L305) uses _client_email(db,q) wrapper which delegates to _resolve_client_email — same resolution rules but does NOT raise 400 (best-effort, matches original semantics). Confirmed no fallback to general email.
Sender/company argument to send_email(...) is unchanged in all touched routes — only the recipient (to) was refactored. Sender not touched, as required.
Out-of-scope confirmed: notifications._recipient (internal notify_acceptance/notify_payment) still prioritizes company.notify_email — this was NOT modified in this iteration, as intended.

Note (informational, not a blocker): quotations create endpoint requires executive_id when client has executives, so 'agency with executives but no executive_id' scenario cannot arise at creation time — only via clients whose executives list becomes empty later, or agencies with executives=[]. E2E test covers the latter.
test_credentials: admin@aventurate.mx / Demo2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Note: auth uses HttpOnly cookie session, not Bearer token — /api/auth/login returns user JSON and sets cookie.
seed_data_creation: 3 TEST_ clients (TEST_ClienteDirecto, TEST_AgenciaXYZ w/ 2 executives, TEST_AgenciaSinEjec) + 4 quotations created and cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration62_recipient_resolution.py has module-scoped fixture that logs in with cookie session and creates/tears down TEST_ prefixed clients+quotations. Reusable pattern for future recipient-related tests. Backend requires BASE=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env when running pytest from CLI.
rca of the issue: Original code fell back to client.email (general/CEO mailbox) for agency/wholesale/operator clients when no explicit to_email was provided, flooding the manager/CEO inbox and failing when the general email was absent. Fix centralizes resolution in deps._resolve_client_email: directo→client.email; b2b→executive email by quotation.executive_id, NEVER the general email; explicit typed errors returned when unresolvable (no silent fallback). All customer-facing send paths (send-message, send-payment, request-transfer, booking confirmation) now use this helper.
